blocking_findings.summary: Right-only full-split rows are not detected because extra_join_rows is computed from a feature-left join result whose length cannot exceed the feature row count; the required adversarial test is absent.

Execution-scope and forbidden-label zero counts are copied from expected constants or returned as literals, then compared with the same expectations, so technical qualification can self-certify without event-derived evidence.

allowed_scope: no-label remediation of the two blocking implementation defects
synthetic adversarial tests that do not invoke a real model fit
a new independent final implementation review
not_authorized: requesting or creating a Stage003 one-time run authorization
reading real aggregate or per-job label data rows
